basics.name: First Last
basics.label: Senior Data Scientist · Reliability & Manufacturing ML
basics.summary: Built the labor time model that earned Caterpillar's CEO Award, cutting $4M annually and raising warranty coverage from 16% to 95% of labor events against an 85% target. 25+ years in capital equipment engineering, from the shop floor as a mechanic and welder to enterprise machine learning. Ships production ML for predictive maintenance, forecasting, anomaly detection, and NLP on failure data, IoT telemetry, and ERP systems, with full MLOps lifecycle ownership on AWS and Snowflake. Sets standards adopted beyond the immediate team, including Amazon's fleet design life standard and dealership-wide data governance at Empire Cat.

work.name: Ford Motor Company
work.position: Senior Data Scientist, Manufacturing Intelligence, Machine Learning & AI
highlights: Architect graph network ontology of automotive manufacturing plant equipment within Neo4j and Google Cloud Platform.

work.name: Caterpillar Inc.
highlights: Raised warranty coverage from 16% to 95% of labor events (target: 85%) and eliminated $4M in physical time study labor with a TensorFlow ordinal deep-learning model predicting equipment repair times, reaching 98% exact-class accuracy on the holdout set.
Replaced a regression model (R² 0.54) using sentence transformer embeddings of labor descriptions across 2M+ combinations of labor code, sales model, and build variant.

Found warranty labor times were censored at the published standard and excluded them, building ground truth from time studies, engineering estimates, and outlier-trimmed non-warranty medians instead of inheriting flawed labels.
Governed the model with an explicit abstention rule (no prediction on unseen build variants or job codes) and per-segment validation gates at a 90% floor.

Delivered in one month a parts revenue forecast across 156 global dealers that two prior attempts over two years had not produced: a time series decomposition neural network forecasting parts dollars per technician at 3% MAPE, separating trend, seasonality, and residual.
Embedded a clustering model in Power BI to track dealer trends over time, giving Caterpillar a basis to engage dealers on service operations, marketing, and training programs.
work.stack: Python, R, SQL · PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, XGBoost, scikit-learn · Snowflake · AWS (SageMaker, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) · Docker · Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions

work.name: Amazon
highlights: Replaced compliance-dependent failure reporting with a machine-generated signal: built a pipeline consuming hourly serialized component logs from S3 and reconstructed true component life from serial-number changes, then moved the fleet design standard from average life to B10.
Applied Weibull and survival analysis across a global fleet of 400,000 autonomous robots, informing maintenance strategy and design metrics network-wide.
Led a team of 5 BI engineers building a global robot monitoring pipeline (R/Shiny, AWS) adopted across sites for incident response and proactive maintenance.
work.stack: R, Python · scikit-learn, AutoGluon · Shiny · PostgreSQL · Docker · AWS (Redshift, Athena, SageMaker, S3)

work.name: Empire Cat
work.position: Reliability Engineering Manager & Data Engineering Manager
highlights: Led modeling on a 25-person cross-functional program that replaced Caterpillar's estimated engine life target with an evidence-based one: reduced thousands of candidate factors via PCA to 9 controllable variables, then built a diesel engine digital twin on live telemetry to monitor them, extending haul truck engine life 23%.
Connected reliability Weibull models to parts demand, which reduced part stockouts by 25%.

Architected a component exchange program with data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and time series models to target at-risk components, with client-facing ownership of the reliability and product problem management programs.
Established data engineering governance, quality standards, and a metadata framework adopted across the dealership.
